description: I'm Mack Doheny. Spent 35 years running into burning houses and busted-open front doors — now I want to keep you out of both situations. This channel is straight talk from a retired fire captain: the fire safety habits that actually save lives, and the home security fixes that don't cost a fortune. No fearmongering, no product pushing — just what I'd tell my own family. If you own a home or care about the people in it, you're in the right place.
